name: CaseGridChildGrowInvalid
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "grid-child-grow-invalid" (grid-sizing). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: layout.grow / flex-grow on a child of a grid parent
